AUTOMACAO_MODELOS.TEXTO: Tap a template to see how it works. The Guide builds it with you and nothing turns on until you say so.
AUTOMACAO_MODELOS.COMO_2: The Guide only asks what belongs to your account, such as the pipeline stage and who gets the alert.
AUTOMACAO_MODELOS.COMO_3: You see what it would do in a real conversation, and only then turn it on.
AUTOMACAO_MODELOS.PEDIDO: I want an automation like this: {titulo}. {texto}

M01.TEXTO: A month before it expires, the customer gets a reminder. If they don't reply, they get a link to book a time.

M02.TEXTO: Whoever fills in the ad form gets a message within minutes and can book a call.

M03.TEXTO: Sends the care tips, asks if everything went well and reminds them to come back. If something goes wrong, you know right away.

M04.TITULO: Keep customers who start to drift
M04.TEXTO: On the first missed visit, the customer is invited to reschedule. On the second, the team is told to call.

M05.TITULO: Remind the next visit at the right time
M05.TEXTO: After the service, the system notes what is left for next time and reminds the customer on the date. If they put it off, it offers a treat.

M06.TITULO: Birthday wishes that become a booking
M06.TEXTO: On their birthday, the customer gets a message with a gift and a link to book.

M07.TEXTO: Past buyers get the deal a day early. Anyone who asks to stop never gets it again.

M08.TITULO: A customer's list becomes one request per person
M08.TEXTO: The customer sends a list of names. Each person becomes a card in the pipeline and gets the document request.

M09.TEXTO: Every Monday, the system finds new companies, sends an introduction and only brings you the ones who are interested.

M10.TITULO: Angry customers go straight to the manager
M10.TEXTO: When a customer is very upset, the chat leaves the automatic service and the manager gets a summary right away.

M11.TEXTO: Whoever refers a friend gets a gift when the friend buys. The friend gets a discount.

M12.TITULO: After the visit, the next step
M12.TEXTO: After the visit, the customer is asked what they thought and the salesperson is reminded to take notes and send the proposal.

M13.TEXTO: After closing, the system confirms the details, reminds the team before the day and asks for a review afterwards.

M14.TEXTO: Asks for the documents, checks each photo or PDF, asks only for what is missing and tells you when everything is ready.

M15.TEXTO: Orders above the amount you choose go straight to you, marked as a priority.

M16.TEXTO: Anyone who went with someone else almost a year ago gets a better offer.

M17.TEXTO: When someone goes on holiday, whoever covers gets a summary of each customer. When they're back, the customers go back to them.

M18.TEXTO: A CV that arrives on WhatsApp becomes a card with the main details, and the best ones get an interview invitation.

M19.TEXTO: If WhatsApp can't deliver, the system tries by email and asks for the new number.

M20.TITULO: Closed sales go into your system
M20.TEXTO: When a sale closes, the system gets the missing details, sends them to your billing system and sends a welcome message.
